## 2A. Technology stack

What it is written in, as answered on the stack screen. This is written into `03-ARCHITECTURE-SPEC.md` section 2 in full, with the reason for each choice and what it displaced.

| Layer | Technology | Version | Source | Because |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Language | TypeScript | 5.7 | Confirmed | Q6 said SPA + API, and one language across the client and the server removes the whole class of contract drift between them. |
| Runtime / framework | NestJS | 11 | Confirmed | Structure and dependency injection, which is what keeps a TypeScript service navigable past about twenty endpoints. |
| Frontend / UI toolkit | React + Vite | React 19 / Vite 6 | Confirmed | Q6 said SPA + API — the largest component ecosystem, and a build that stays out of the way. |
| Data access | Prisma | 6 | Confirmed | One schema file generates the client types and the migration, so the two cannot disagree. |
| Data store | PostgreSQL | 17 | Confirmed | Q4 said a database. |
| Data platform | `DECISION REQUIRED` | — | — | Where analytical data is moved and modelled |
| Messaging / streaming | None — synchronous calls only | — | Confirmed | Nothing in the answers requires a broker, and a broker is an operational commitment. Components call each other and wait until that stops being true. |
| Key libraries | `DECISION REQUIRED` | — | — | Anything else a reader must have to build it |
| Testing | Vitest, Playwright | 2.1 / 1.49 | Confirmed | Runs the same transform as the build, so a test cannot pass on code the bundler would reject. Q1 said a web application with an interface — cross-browser end to end, with tracing that makes a flaky failure diagnosable. |
| Build | Vite | 6 | Confirmed | Fast dev server and an optimised production build. |
| Packaging | Docker image | OCI | Confirmed | One artefact that carries its own runtime, so the environment a test passed in is the environment that ships. |
| Hosting / runtime target | Managed app platform | — | Confirmed | Deploy the artefact and let the platform own the rest. Kubernetes is more control and an order of magnitude more operations, and nothing in the answers asks for it yet. |

**Catalog** means the option and its version came from the builder's own list and are a starting point to confirm. **Author-supplied** means somebody typed it, and it is theirs. A version is not a decision until somebody has checked it against what is actually released.
